shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ މުޅި ހަށިގަނޑަށް ނޭނގޭ ހަމަހިމޭންކަމެއް ވެރިވި. ބައްޕަގެ ޤަތުލަށް އިންސާފު ހޯދިއްޖެ. ނިމުނީ.
shots.narration_english: An unknown peace came over his whole being. Justice had been found for his father's murder. The End.
